messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'not recommended in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not recommended for the specified patient group or condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has other uses': The subject drug may be used for purposes that are not specified or listed in the provided medication guide.
D. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
